subject: Intro call — availability matrix for Leo Fernandes
messages:
From: Leo Fernandes <leo.fernandes@gmail.com>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 25 Apr 2027 08:12:00 -0500
Subject: Application — backend infra role

Hi Diego,

Thanks for reviewing my application for the backend infrastructure role. Attached is my resume and a short note about my background — I worked on low-latency streaming systems at my last company. I live in Lisbon (UTC+1) and am generally available after 14:00 local time on weekdays.

A few windows that work this week (all Lisbon time):
- Tue 14:30–16:00
- Wed 15:00–17:00
- Thu 09:00–11:00 (earlier slot)

Happy to share a calendar invite once you confirm a time. Looking forward to a quick intro.

Best,
Leo

[Attachment: leo_resume.pdf (pdf)]

From: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.ai>
To: Leo Fernandes <leo.fernandes@gmail.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 25 Apr 2027 09:05:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Application — backend infra role

Hi Leo — thanks for the quick note and the resume. Marissa (hiring manager) is cc'd. To make scheduling faster, can you confirm the matrix below (I put the times in both Lisbon and our local Pacific window so it's straightforward):

Availability matrix (Lisbon / Redwood PT):
- Tue 14:30–15:00 (Lisbon) — Tue 06:30–07:00 PT
- Tue 15:00–15:30 (Lisbon) — Tue 07:00–07:30 PT
- Wed 15:30–16:00 (Lisbon) — Wed 07:30–08:00 PT
- Thu 09:00–09:30 (Lisbon) — Thu 01:00–01:30 PT (earlier for us)

We prefer a 20–25 minute intro with one of our engineers + hiring manager listening in for the first 10 minutes. If any of those slots work, tell me which one you prefer and your timezone label (you mentioned Lisbon but confirm if currently on WEST/BST). If none are good, drop 3 alternative slots in UTC and I will coordinate.

Quick note on format: agenda will be 10 min introductions, 10 min high-level system design / past work, 5 min next steps.

If you want to book immediately, here's my calendar link: https://cal.redwood.ai/diego/20m

Thanks —
Diego Fernandez
Technical Recruiter | Redwood Inference
diego.fernandez@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0183

From: Leo Fernandes <leo.fernandes@gmail.com>

Hi Diego — thanks, that matrix is super helpful. I'm currently on WEST (Lisbon, UTC+1) — DST is in effect. The best slot for me is Tue 15:00–15:30 Lisbon (your Tue 07:00–07:30 PT). I can do Wed 15:30–16:00 as a backup.

Please confirm which one you book; Tue 15:00 Lisbon works well.

Best,
Leo
